meta.notes: The banner pattern. asset_id names its two pictures in this namespace: textures/entity/banner/ocean_ring.png for banners and textures/entity/shield/ocean_ring.png for shields, pale masks the game dyes in the colour chosen in the loom (a ring drawn by MSM; paint over them to change the shape). translation_key is the start of its name: the game adds the dye colour, so block.msm_examples.banner.ocean_ring.red reads "Red Ocean Ring".
